name: @itc-steve/pi-fgt
description: Pi extension: read-only multi-device FortiGate (FortiOS REST) tools — firewall, VPN, FortiAP, FortiSwitch

scripts.test: npm run test:filters && npm run test:validate && npm run test:config
scripts.test:filters: out=$(mktemp -d) && tsc --noEmit false --outDir "$out" && node "$out/filters/engine.test.js"; code=$?; rm -rf "$out"; exit $code
scripts.test:validate: out=$(mktemp -d) && tsc --noEmit false --outDir "$out" && node "$out/validate.test.js"; code=$?; rm -rf "$out"; exit $code
scripts.test:config: out=$(mktemp -d) && tsc --noEmit false --outDir "$out" && node "$out/config-management.test.js"; code=$?; rm -rf "$out"; exit $code
